requirements:
# Core packages
pytest
setuptools
packaging
requests
nose
pandas
wheel
IPython
numpy
pip

# Development dependencies for VS Code Jupyter extension
jupyter
jupyterlab
ipykernel
matplotlib
seaborn
scipy
scikit-learn
notebook
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install dependencies
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Set environment variables
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

# Default command (can be overridden)
CMD ["python", "-m", "pytest"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes all detected imports plus common Jupyter ecosystem packages needed for VS Code Jupyter extension development. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base image, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, sets up proper environment variables, and defaults to running pytest for testing. The slim image reduces size while maintaining Python functionality.
